user.title: Downtime Auditor
user.description: Reports automations that were missed or interrupted while Home Assistant was restarting or down.

data.push_only_on_findings: Push only when something was found

data_description.sidebar_panel: Add a Downtime Auditor dashboard to the sidebar (admins only).
data_description.repairs: Raise an issue in Settings → Repairs for every interrupted automation and missed trigger.
data_description.repairs_possible: Also raise Repairs issues for lower-confidence findings.
data_description.persistent_notification: Also post the full report to the notification panel (off by default; the dashboard replaces it).
data_description.notify_service: e.g. notify.mobile_app_pixel_8 or script.notify_send_message_to_phone (receives title + message). Leave blank to disable.
data_description.push_only_on_findings: Skip the phone push when nothing was missed or interrupted.
data_description.write_json: Save each report to /config/downtime_auditor/reports and append a line to history.jsonl.
data_description.retention: Older report files are deleted; history.jsonl is kept.
data_description.heartbeat_interval: How often state is snapshotted to disk. Sets the accuracy of the window start after a crash or power loss.
data_description.startup_delay: Wait this long after HA has started before analysing, so integrations can restore their real states.
data_description.include_scripts: Also report scripts that were running when HA went down.
data_description.include_unverifiable: List event/webhook/MQTT-style triggers whose missed firings can't be reconstructed.
data_description.max_window_days: Cap on how far back to look after a long outage.

error.invalid_service: Use the form notify.xxx or script.xxx

analyze_window.name: Analyze a what-if window
analyze_window.description: Report which time, time-pattern, sun and calendar triggers would be missed if HA were down between start and end. Useful for testing.

notify.name: Notify
notify.description: Also show the result as a persistent notification.

resend_last_report.name: Resend last report
resend_last_report.description: Re-send the most recent downtime report to the persistent notification and push service.

snapshot_now.name: Snapshot now
snapshot_now.description: Capture the baseline and running-automation snapshot immediately (for debugging).

dismiss_repairs.name: Dismiss repairs
dismiss_repairs.description: Remove all Repairs issues raised by the latest report.
